    <section class="hero wrap" aria-labelledby="intro">
      <div class="eyebrow"><span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span> PRATHYUSHA CHALLA · PRODUCT MANAGER</div>
      <h1 id="intro">Complex problems.<br>Clear direction.<br><span>Meaningful products.</span></h1>
      <div class="hero-bottom"><p>I turn customer needs into product strategy, thoughtful experiences and shipped SaaS products. My work spans healthcare AI, supply chain and e-commerce.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="button" href="#work">Explore my work <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a><a class="text-link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathyusha-ch/">Connect on LinkedIn <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div>
      <div class="hero-foot"><span>BASED IN BENGALURU, INDIA</span><span>STRATEGY → DISCOVERY → DELIVERY</span></div>
    </section>
    <section class="impact" aria-label="Career impact"><div class="wrap metrics"><div><strong>13 years</strong><span>Building products &amp; solving problems</span></div><div><strong>200+</strong><span>Customers reached by a B2B MVP</span></div><div><strong>5 pp</strong><span>Reduction in customer churn</span></div><div><strong>20 people</strong><span>Cross-functional team led</span></div></div></section>
    <section class="section wrap" id="work" aria-labelledby="work-title">
      <div class="section-heading"><div><div class="eyebrow">01 / SELECTED WORK</div><h2 id="work-title">Strategy meets execution.</h2></div><p>Selected projects across healthcare AI, supply chain and enterprise SaaS, with a focus on the decisions and outcomes.</p></div>
      <article class="project project-featured"><div class="project-number">01</div><div class="project-body"><div class="tags"><span>HEALTHCARE AI</span><span>OPTUM / UHG</span></div><h3>Modernizing healthcare<br>with responsible AI.</h3><p>Leading the modernization of a healthcare AI product, replatforming legacy capabilities and aligning product strategy with client needs and regulatory requirements.</p><div class="project-detail"><h4>My contribution</h4><p>Define features, user stories and roadmap priorities. Coordinate releases across engineering, QA and security, embedding Responsible AI and data privacy into product design.</p></div><div class="project-detail"><h4>From idea to validation</h4><p>Create Figma demos for rapid client validation, deliver stakeholder dashboards, and drive product demos and product council approvals.</p></div></div><div class="project-aside"><span class="aside-label">PRODUCT FOCUS</span><p>Client value.<br>Privacy by design.<br>Faster validation.</p><span class="aside-caption">Product Manager · May 2023 onward</span></div></article>
      <article class="project"><div class="project-number">02</div><div class="project-body"><div class="tags"><span>B2B SAAS</span><span>OBOPAY</span></div><h3>A supply chain product,<br>built from zero.</h3><p>Created a B2B supply chain management product from scratch, defining the roadmap and go-to-market strategy while coordinating engineering, design, testing, IT and marketing.</p><div class="project-detail"><h4>My contribution</h4><p>Led a team of 20, partnered with sales on market demand and presales, and brought customer feedback into product decisions.</p></div></div><div class="project-aside"><strong class="result">200+</strong><span class="result-label">customers at MVP launch</span><span class="aside-caption">Senior Business Analyst · 2018–2019</span></div></article>
      <article class="project"><div class="project-number">03</div><div class="project-body"><div class="tags"><span>ADOPTION &amp; RETENTION</span><span>VXCEED</span></div><h3>Better onboarding.<br>Stronger retention.</h3><p>Worked across product and project management for a B2B supply chain SaaS platform, with implementations for companies including Abbott, Unilever and HCCB.</p><div class="project-detail"><h4>My contribution</h4><p>Improved customer onboarding, gathered feedback and provided proactive support. Built SQL-powered Tableau reports and mentored five associate consultants.</p></div></div><div class="project-aside"><strong class="result">15% → 10%</strong><span class="result-label">customer churn reduction</span><span class="aside-caption">Functional Consultant · 2015–2018</span></div></article>
      <article class="project"><div class="project-number">04</div><div class="project-body"><div class="tags"><span>DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION</span><span>NESS / S&amp;P GLOBAL</span></div><h3>A roadmap for<br>mobile transformation.</h3><p>Created a three-quarter roadmap to take a web-based ratings product onto mobile, informed by competitive research, market research and direct conversations with users.</p><div class="project-detail"><h4>My contribution</h4><p>Conducted user interviews, workshops and focus groups; translated stakeholder needs into prioritized requirements, product backlogs and user stories in Azure DevOps.</p></div></div><div class="project-aside"><strong class="result">3 quarters</strong><span class="result-label">digital transformation roadmap</span><span class="aside-caption">Senior Business Analyst · 2019–2021</span></div></article>
    </section>
    <section class="experience-section" id="experience" aria-labelledby="experience-title"><div class="wrap section"><div class="section-heading"><div><div class="eyebrow">02 / THE JOURNEY</div><h2 id="experience-title">A technical foundation.<br>A product mindset.</h2></div><p>From software engineering and business analysis to leading product strategy and cross-functional delivery.</p></div><div class="timeline">
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">MAY 2023 ONWARD</div><div><h3>Product Manager</h3><span class="company">Optum (UnitedHealth Group)</span><p>Healthcare AI modernization, roadmap ownership, Responsible AI, client validation and release coordination.</p></div></article>
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">APR 2021 — APR 2023</div><div><h3>Senior Consultant</h3><span class="company">Deloitte USI</span><p>Healthcare and e-commerce SaaS products. Partnered with design on user experience, managed epics and features in Jira, and coordinated non-functional requirements across development and testing.</p></div></article>
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">OCT 2019 — APR 2021</div><div><h3>Senior Business Analyst</h3><span class="company">Ness Technologies · S&amp;P Global engagement</span><p>Mobile transformation planning, market research, stakeholder discovery and backlog management in Azure DevOps.</p></div></article>
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">DEC 2018 — OCT 2019</div><div><h3>Senior Business Analyst</h3><span class="company">Obopay Mobile Technology</span><p>B2B supply chain product creation, MVP delivery, go-to-market strategy and leadership of a 20-person team.</p></div></article>
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">JUN 2015 — DEC 2018</div><div><h3>Functional Consultant</h3><span class="company">Vxceed Software Solutions</span><p>Enterprise supply chain implementations, customer retention, analytics, presales and consultant mentoring.</p></div></article>
      <article class="role"><div class="role-date">JUL 2011 — FEB 2014</div><div><h3>Software Engineer</h3><span class="company">Soft Smith Infotech</span><p>Requirements gathering, project planning, UAT, engineering support and user documentation.</p></div></article>
    </div></div></section>
    <section class="section wrap toolkit" aria-labelledby="toolkit-title"><div><div class="eyebrow">03 / HOW I WORK</div><h2 id="toolkit-title">Customer empathy.<br>Technical fluency.</h2><p>I connect business goals, user needs and engineering realities to help teams decide what to build and bring it to market.</p></div><div class="capabilities"><div><h3>Product &amp; delivery</h3><p>Product strategy · Roadmaps · Discovery · Prioritization · Go-to-market · Scrum · Stakeholder alignment</p></div><div><h3>Design, data &amp; technology</h3><p>UI/UX · Figma · SQL · Tableau · Backend APIs · ETL · Copilot · No-code platforms · Jira · Azure DevOps</p></div><div><h3>Education &amp; credentials</h3><p>Certified Scrum Master · Scrum Alliance<br>Bachelor’s in Electrical &amp; Electronics Engineering · SCSVMV University<br>MBA candidate, Business Analytics · Deakin University</p></div></div></section>
    <section class="contact wrap" aria-labelledby="contact-title"><div class="eyebrow">LET’S CONNECT</div><h2 id="contact-title">Good products start<br>with a conversation.</h2><p>Explore my full experience or connect with me on LinkedIn.</p><div class="contact-actions"><a class="button" href="data:application/pdf;base64," download="Prathyusha-Challa-Resume.pdf">View my resume <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><a class="text-link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathyusha-ch/">Find me on LinkedIn <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></section>
